plain.li: [arrive] This is the gate, then.
[arrive,bring] We've brought what was promised.
[arrive,take] We're here for what was agreed.
[arrive,theirLowtech] We left before first light to get here.
[arrive,theirHightech] Right place, good, let's get this done.
[arrive,rain] Wet the whole way here.
[arrive,snow] Snow up to the knees on the pass.
[arrive,winter] Cold road. We won't stay long.
[arrive,summer] Hot work, walking that far with a load.
[arrive,morning] Early start. We'd like to be home by dark.
[await] I'll wait here by the gate.
[await,silver] Someone's bringing the silver out, I was told.
[await,food] I'll take the food back to the ones who need it.
[await,medicine] Our healer's waiting on this.
[await,wood] I've brought a strap for the timber.
[await,theirLowtech] Tell your people the runner has come.
[deliver,silver] Count it if you like, it's all there.
[deliver,silver,theirLowtech] Every coin, as the elders said.
[deliver,silver,theirHightech] There's your payment, to the last coin.
[deliver,food] Mind that sack, the seam's going.
[deliver,medicine] Keep these dry and they'll keep.
[deliver,wood] Stacked it as straight as I could.
[deliver,goods] That's the lot, have a look through it.
[deliver] Set down safe.
[collect,food] Good weight to these.
[collect,food,theirLowtech] There'll be bread at home tonight.
[collect,silver] I'll count it again on the road.
[collect,wood] Dry timber. They'll be glad of it at home.
[collect,medicine] This'll be with the sick by tomorrow.
[collect] One load done, now the rest.
[receive] That's what I came for.
[receive,silver] All here. I'll see it gets where it's going.
[receive,food] This will be shared out tonight.
[receive,medicine] Our healer will be glad of this.
[receive,wood] Home before dark with this, if the road's kind.
[leave] Long walk home.
[leave,theirLowtech] Back before the moon's up, if we hurry.
[leave,rain] Back out into the wet, then.
[fetch,person] On your feet, you're coming with us.
[fetch,person,theirLowtech] The elders will want a word with you.
[fetch,person,theirHightech] You'll answer for it where you belong.
[fetch,animal] There you are, come on, home.
[fetch,animal] Easy now. Easy.
[inperson,silver] Here. As we agreed.
[inperson] This is yours now.
[inperson,goods] Yours. Look it over.
[inperson,food] It isn't much, but it's good.
[arrive,letter] I've a letter to put in your hands.
[arrive,letter,theirLowtech] I ran the whole way with this letter.
[arrive,letter,theirHightech] Message for your council, by hand as asked.
[await,letter] I'm here for your letter, whenever it's ready.
[await,letter,theirLowtech] I'll carry your words back before the next moon.
[await,letter,theirHightech] I was told there's a letter to collect here.
[receive,letter] I'll put it in the right hands and no others.
[receive,letter,theirLowtech] Your words will be read out at our fire.
[receive,letter,theirHightech] Sealed and in my bag, it goes straight there.
[deliver,letter] This is for your people, from mine.
[deliver,letter,theirLowtech] Words from my people, carried the whole way.
[deliver,letter,theirHightech] Your answer, delivered by hand as promised.
[road,ws:water] The ford below {PLACE} is under water, I came round by the hill.
[road,ws:water] Half the road to {PLACE} is mud since the river came up.
[road,ws:water,ws:theirs] The river's in the lower houses at home, I came out over the bridge while it still stood.
[road,ws:sickness] They've shut the gate at {PLACE} for the fever, so I went round.
[road,ws:sickness] Every inn on the road asks where you've come from before they let you in.
[road,ws:sickness,ws:theirs] We've shut our own gate at {PLACE} for {NAME}, I came out by the back road.
[road,ws:hunger] There's nothing to buy to eat on the road this side of {PLACE}.
[road,ws:hunger,ws:theirs] I'd stay for a bite if you offer, there's not much of it at home.
[road,ws:fair] Half the road is wagons going to the fair at {PLACE}.
[road,ws:fair,ws:theirs] The whole of {PLACE} is stalls and tents for the fair, I could hardly get out.
[road,ws:faith] The road's full of pilgrims walking to {PLACE}, I've never seen so many.
[road,ws:war] I kept off the main road, there's fighting near {PLACE}.
[road,ws:war,ws:theirs] Our people are at war, so mind who you let through your gate.
[road,ws:roads] I came the long way, the road by {PLACE} isn't safe these days.
[road,ws:drought] The wells along the road are nearly dry, I had to carry my own water.
[road,ws:weather] It's been cold the whole way from {PLACE}, colder than any year I remember.
[road,ws:fire] You can still smell the smoke from {PLACE} on the road.
[road,ws:fire,ws:theirs] Half of {PLACE} burned, and I've been sleeping in a barn since.
[road,ws:mourning] Every house in {PLACE} has black on the door.
[road,ws:songs] Every inn on the road is singing that new song, the one about this place.
[road,ws:comet] People stop on the road at night to look at the comet.
[road,ws:harvest] The carts going past {PLACE} are piled high, it's a good year there.
[road,ws:harvest,ws:theirs] It's been a fine harvest at home, and I'm told to say we'll be selling.
[road,ws:herds] I had to wait half a morning for a herd to cross the road.
[road,ws:drove] The drove road's full, I walked behind cattle half the way.
[road,ws:trade] The road to {PLACE} is busy with carts, trade's good this season.
[road,ws:road] The new road's open past {PLACE}, it saved me half a day.
[road,ws:toll] There's a toll at {PLACE} now, so I went round by the fields.
[road,wsdef:Council_WS_Assize] The road's full of people going to the assize at {PLACE}.
[road,ws:court] Everyone on the road is talking about {NAME} at {PLACE}.
[road,ws:levy] The Empire's men are on the road collecting the levy, I kept my head down.
[road,ws:rush] Everyone on the road is heading for the diggings, I was the only one going the other way.
[road,ws:sellswords] There are sellswords camped by the road near {PLACE}, I didn't stop.
[road,ws:ice] The river's frozen hard by {PLACE}, the carts are driving right across it.
[road,ws:scarcity] The traders I passed had none of what everyone's asking for.
[road,ws:exile] I passed a lot of people on the road carrying everything they own.
[road,ws:rebuild] They're rebuilding at {PLACE}, the road is all carts of timber and stone.
[road,ws:beast] Everyone at {PLACE} is talking about the beast, so I kept to the open road.
[road,ws:embargo] The market at {PLACE} is shut to outsiders, I couldn't even buy water there.
[road,ws:peace] The road past {PLACE} is busy with envoys going to the talks.
[road,ws:wreck] People are going up the road to {PLACE} to pick over the wreck.
[road,ws:healer] Everyone on the road says there's a healer at {PLACE} who can mend anything.
[road,ws:town] There's a new town going up near {PLACE}, the road's busy with settlers.
[road,ws:feud] I went round {PLACE}, there's a feud on and strangers get asked whose side they're on.
[road,ws:creed] I kept my mouth shut at {PLACE}, nobody there wants to hear of any other faith just now.

warm.li: [arrive] Your fields look well from the road.
[deliver] With thanks from all of us.
[receive] We won't forget who sent this.
[inperson] For your trouble, and with thanks.
[fetch,animal] They've missed you at home, you know.

cheerful.li: [arrive] Made good time on the road!
[deliver] Ha, my shoulders are light again.
[collect] Full load! They'll cheer when this comes up the road.

gloomy.li: [arrive] My feet won't forgive me for this road.
[deliver] Heavier than it looks, all of it.
[collect] Uphill all the way back, with this.
[await] I'll stand here till someone tells me otherwise.

cold.li: [collect] As agreed. No more, no less.
[receive] Received. We'll be on our way.
[fetch,person] Don't make this harder than it needs to be.
